counts_note: 16 oracle specifications and planned designs are not test executions or PASS counts.
method: Literal access/state/output/side-effect expectations from original requirements and committed contract. Baseline source identifies observation points only; no implementation output generates expected answers, no cloned business algorithm or project imports.
planned_bounded_composites: Original HTTP ADOPT/P1/P2/ordinary ACCEPT/P3/manual ACK/P4 explicit VERIFY then cold goal-results and original full-page pack
Missing predecessor and false VERIFY/event/receipt proof refuse without new business verification
Revoke/restore/catalogue ABA and fresh process preserve deadline and invalidate current source
Actual owned lock wait crossing original persisted deadline rejects VERIFY and stale CURRENT result
Explicit ordinary/default/old-isolated cross-app context isolation and unchanged Run read refusal
P5 plus unsupported/PARTIAL goals remain present and conservatively unverified
remaining_limits: Implementation not reviewed or executed yet
Exact missing/current real initialization identities, grants, catalogue and source inputs must be reported by delivery
Formal trusted-source/Native installation gaps unchanged; no new authority fabrication

specifications.boundary: No implicit Store discovery, legacy-denial catch/fallback, process-global participant cache, cross-app scope leak or new Run read rights.
specifications.expected: Only exact ordinary CURRENT_PREPARATION service explicitly injected by configured_app/create_app into the same Store selects ordinary P3/P4 source inspection, including original internal plan gates. A marker classifies proof but does not select permission or grant authority.
specifications.title: Explicit ordinary dependency chooses the source path

specifications.boundary: Original whole-Run, whole-Case, plan and goal-results role guards remain. No identity/Grant/assignment/catalogue/approval/credential or permission issuance.
specifications.expected: Default/unconfigured and old isolated admission retain their original refusals for ordinary marker history. Old isolated/legacy/foreign/corrupt markers are never adopted into ordinary plan proofs. Any surviving active/inactive Run assignment, Native history or mixed provider denies ordinary use.
specifications.title: Default/old protocols and Native remain refused

specifications.boundary: Structural corruption and scope mismatch refuse accurately. Unknown/unsupported and PARTIAL goals retain their original states and full order; they are not silently removed to obtain success.
specifications.expected: A legal adopted ordinary Case with no OFFER, no ACCEPT or no ACK has pending P3/P4 outputs and cannot be verified as current. That absence alone does not invalidate valid P1/P2 or manufacture a receipt/event.
specifications.title: Missing output is not malformed proof

specifications.boundary: No automatic CHECK/VERIFY/ADOPT or Case completion. ACK alone never creates a plan verification. Original UUID, source fingerprint and first deadline survive a recreated API/service.
specifications.expected: Original explicit ADOPT, owner P1 VERIFY, current resource business and owner P2 VERIFY precede ordinary OFFER and executor ACCEPT. P3 requires original ACCEPT to receipt CREATE proof. P4 requires the real current manual SUBMIT history and independent owner ACK. P3/P4 become current verified local outputs only after separate original owner VERIFY.
specifications.title: Original positive ordered HTTP chain

specifications.boundary: Keep original dependency graph/constraints, manual-lock behavior and reason/key rules; ordinary admission does not make an empty predecessor set a bypass.
specifications.expected: Missing/invalid P1 material/catalogue proof, P2 resource decision/rules/claims/constraints or prior owner verification blocks the corresponding later business/VERIFY. Wrong owner/role/Case, READ/PREPARE/EXECUTE loss, stale plan/source revision or wrong expected source hash cannot commit VERIFY.
specifications.title: P1/P2 predecessors and original owner decision remain gates

specifications.boundary: False boolean revisions, copied foreign IDs, false ACCEPT/CREATE, wrong fingerprint/coordinates, altered receipt text/hash/version/actor or forged ACK cannot yield CURRENT; malformed sources refuse or remain unverified without500 or authority fallback.
specifications.expected: P3 source binds exact first OFFER typed marker/fingerprint, Case/Run/preparation/participants/deadline/generations and original ACCEPT to CREATE. P4 source binds actual step/current receipt, continuous receipt versions, original executor SUBMIT and owner ACK with exact actor/revision/hash/source.
specifications.title: Original ordinary event/receipt proof is exact

specifications.boundary: Identical allowed key replay has its original effect once; a different body/source conflicts. A source-type change is not silently accepted as an old current verification.
specifications.expected: A verified_sha256 field without its exact original owner VERIFY event bound to this plan/step/source is not output verification. Old source hashes cannot be reused for a source that now includes ordinary admission proof; original ADOPT/VERIFY fingerprints and immutable history are never rewritten.
specifications.title: VERIFY history authenticates the reported result

specifications.boundary: An authorized current owner may retain a legitimate expired/revoked offer history and old verification reference, but P3/P4 are no longer current. A late transaction that computed CURRENT before expiry must recompute/refuse that response, never return false current or commit VERIFY.
specifications.expected: The original first OFFER absolute database deadline remains at most300s from creation and is never renewed by plan/results read, VERIFY retry, restart, reconfiguration or revoke/restore. ACCEPT/SUBMIT/ACK/VERIFY require live original deadline and generations.
specifications.title: Persistent deadline and historical distinction

specifications.boundary: Historical owner scope does not itself require EXECUTE, but new VERIFY does. Do not replace an old recorded generation with the latest restored generation or substitute current material for historical originals.
specifications.expected: Owner/reviewer/executor principal or READ/PREPARE/REVIEW_ASSIGNED/EXECUTE generation revoke/restore, material revision/hash change or catalogue hash/xmin change/restoration makes the original ordinary proof stale across a fresh process.
specifications.title: ABA and changed sources do not revive old proof

specifications.boundary: No physical COMMIT-instant atomic expiry claim. Original rejected-observation metadata semantics remain separate from new business/VERIFY commits; source checks are not moved before blocking work.
specifications.expected: Current token, scope, exact original source and first deadline are checked after final waits on parent/resource/Case/ledger/plan key/event history, including waits during the final result projection. A crossing expiry/revocation/source change rolls back new VERIFY or refuses/recomputes stale CURRENT output.
specifications.title: After every possible source/plan lock wait

specifications.boundary: No material body, fact value/excerpt, receipt body, raw marker generations/private source snapshot, credentials or another enterprise data. Manual synthetic text remains different from adapter-generated output; case_goal_completed=false and external/physical claims remain absent.
specifications.expected: Owner-only original goal-results reports exact current accepted offer/receipt/owner VERIFY references only when all current source and predecessor checks hold. Current and historical verification are distinct. No readable source authority means no private source business IDs/content hashes; retain only allowed own plan/step historical references and blocker reasons.
specifications.title: Goal-results output is true and minimal

specifications.boundary: Existing installed schema and legal current participants/grants/catalogue are consumed only. No fixture-issued ordinary success, positive owner authority repair or new algorithm/schema/format.
specifications.expected: Fresh ordinary configured_app/service reads the same persisted plan UUID, original output references, deadline, row/trace fingerprints and historical VERIFY when inputs are unchanged. Goal-results and pack refreshes do not create business or authority rows.
specifications.title: Cold read and no hidden business writes

specifications.boundary: Late200/403 or identity/Case ABA cannot restore a stale private pack. Current403 clears private views; UNKNOWN/in-flight write blocks output while preserving original opaque recovery handles/drafts. No automatic POST or token/body persistence; Node VM is not a real-browser claim.
specifications.expected: Original goal-results panel generates and downloads the original whitelist TXT pack only after its original two fresh authenticated GETs per action. Full current goals/results/order, plan/request/source bindings, row/trace hashes, historical references, reasons and limits match; between-read change clears the candidate.
specifications.title: Original complete-page case-record pack

specifications.boundary: No ordinary-source fallback inside life._sources, local REVALIDATE or CLOSE. Unsupported/unknown goals and PARTIAL remain; no external fulfillment, institution acceptance, wholeCase success or formal AT35 claim.
specifications.expected: Ordinary P3/P4 adaptation never changes original lifecycle P5 authorization/source/write gates. A plan including LOCAL_CASE_RECORD_RECHECK retains that required goal and cannot claim all outputs verified solely because P1-P4 are current.
specifications.title: P5 stays original and conservative

specifications.boundary: Source injection is transaction/local-call bound; only original current role scopes choose permissions. Marker/value edits and source IDs do not become a trusted identity or new share capability.
specifications.expected: Interleaved ordinary and default apps, multiple Cases and different current participants retain exact per-request Store/Case/source context. After exceptions or nested source calls, explicit ordinary context cannot leak into an unconfigured call or another request.
specifications.title: Concurrent scope and failure cleanup

specifications.boundary: Old54 and previous slices are not rerun/transferred. No tests before source freeze, no real browser/Windows/AT35/models/installation/permission writes. Report concrete current identities/grants/catalogue/source needs and missing management initialization code, rather than calling it only a user-permission gap.
specifications.expected: After a root-frozen implementation SHA, run only a bounded private Git-archive selection with independent literal counterexamples and explicitly counted overlaps. Record collection/setup/call/teardown/JUnit, module origins and source hashes and shared/mirror PREPOST. Retain all failures and XML-safe canonical redaction.
specifications.title: Evidence and real-input limits

static_contract_watchpoints.point: Both authentication parent and P3 authority source require an explicit ordinary path; removing only an issue string cannot close the business source contract.
Original er._fresh and optional P5 life._sources stay distinguishable; ordinary P3/P4 may replace only their exact source proofs, never broader lifecycle authority.
Read-only current owner results require exact owner VERIFY proof and final freshness after source/history waits.
Original pack whitelist, two fresh GETs per generate/download, pending-write/late403 handling, no new format or automatic verification.
